name: 05_cap_hit
description: Per-unit cap 2.5 × 105 = 262.5 USDC (105,000 on 400 units) is reached in the third payment: the payment is truncated, the excess refunded to the issuer, the series Retired, units burned on claim or by a keeper crank; later reports are rejected while treasury releases continue.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: paidPerUnitWad = 56,800 / 400 = 142 USDC per unit; still below the cap
owed 4% × 2,820,000 = 112,800 → payment 56,000; only 48,200 fits under the cap
cap hit: accepted 48,200, refund 7,800 to the issuer, fee 2,410, series Retired
Retired: paidPerUnitWad == cap × WAD; refundedToIssuer 7,800; gross 105,000 = 400 × 262.5
a Retired series cannot be redeemed
claim on a Retired series burns the holder's units
keeper crank: burns b3's units; b3's pending stays claimable
b3 burned but unpaid: holders.b3.pending = 25% of net
all units burned (unitsOutstanding 0); vault empty; fee collector = 420 + 5% × 105,000
Retired series still release on schedule: tranches 3 and 4
